sn35.238:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisā || ||
sn35.238:1.2: Atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikulo ||
sn35.238:1.4: Ime te ambho purisa cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisā kālena kālaṃ vuṭṭhāpetabbā kālena kālaṃ nahāpetabbā kālena kālam bhojetabbā kālena kālam pavesetabbā ||
sn35.238:1.5: yadā ca kho te ambho purisa imesaṃ catunnam āsīvisānam uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānam aññataro vā aññataro vā kuppissati || tato tvam ambho purisa maraṇam vā nigacchissasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ ||
sn35.238:1.6: yan te ambho purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti || || 4
sn35.238:2.1: Atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnam āsīvisānam uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānaṃ yena vā tena vā palāyetha ||
sn35.238:2.3: Ime te ambho purisa pañcavadhakā paccatthikā piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddhā yattheva nam passissāma tattheva jīvitāvoropessāmāti ||
sn35.238:2.4: yan te ambho purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti || || 5
sn35.238:3.1: Atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnam āsīvisānam uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānam bhīto pañcannaṃ vadhakānaṃ paccatthikānaṃ yena vā tena vā palāyetha ||
sn35.238:3.3: Ayan te ambho purisa chaṭṭho antaracaro vadhako ukkhittāsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddho yattheva nam passissāmi tattheva siro pātessāmīti ||
sn35.238:3.4: yan te ambo purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti || || 6
sn35.238:4.1: Atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnam āsīvisānam uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānam bhīto pañcannam vadhakānam paccatthikānam bhīto chaṭṭhassa antaracarassa vadhakassa ukkhittāsikassa yena vā tena vā palāyetha ||
sn35.238:4.3: yaññayad evaṃ gharaṃ paviseyya rittakaññeva paviseyya tucchakaññeva paviseyya suññakaññeva paviseyya ||
sn35.238:4.4: yaññayadeva bhājanam parimaseyya tucchakaññeva parimaseyya suññakaññeva parimaseyya ||
sn35.238:4.6: Idāni ambho purisa imam suññagāmaṃ corā gāmaghātakā vadhissanti ||
sn35.238:4.7: yan te ambho purisa karaṇīyaṃ taṃ karohīti || || 7
sn35.238:5.1: Atha kho so bhikkhave puriso bhīto catunnam āsīvisānam uggatejānaṃ ghoravisānam bhīto pañcannaṃ vadhakānam paccatthikānam bhīto chaṭṭhassa antaracarassa vadhakassa ukkhittāsikassa bhīto corānaṃ gāmaghātakānaṃ yena va tena vā palāyetha || ||
sn35.238:5.2: So passeyya mahantam udakaṇṇavam orimantīram sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayam pārimantīraṃ khemam appaṭibhayaṃ
sn35.238:5.3: na cassa nāvā santāraṇī uttārasetuvā apārāpāraṃgamanāya || || 8
sn35.238:5.4: Atha kho so bhikkhave tassa purisassa evam assa
sn35.238:5.5: Ayaṃ kho mahā udakaṇṇavo orimantīram sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayam pārimantīraṃ khemam appaṭibhayaṃ natthica nāvā santāranī uttārasetu vā aparāpāraṃgamanāya || || Yam
sn35.238:5.6: nūnāhaṃ tiṇakaṭṭha-sākhā-palāsaṃ saṅkaḍḍhitvā kullam bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāram gaccheyyan ti || || 9
sn35.238:6.1: Atha kho so bhikkhave puriso tiṇa-kaṭṭha-sākhā-palāsam saṃkaḍḍhitvā kullam bandhitvā taṃ kullaṃ nissāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyamamāno sotthinā pāraṃ gaccheyya || || tiṇṇo pāraṅgato thale titthati brāhmaṇo || || 10
sn35.238:7.1: Upamā kho myāyam bhikkhave katā atthassa viññāpanāya
sn35.238:7.3: Cattāro āsīvisā uggatejā ghoravisā ti kho bhikkhave catunnetam mahābhūtānam adhivacanaṃ ||
sn35.238:8.1: Pañcavadhakā paccatthikā ti kho bhikkhave pañcannetam upādānakkhandhānam adhivacanam seyyathīdaṃ
sn35.238:9.1: Chaṭṭho antaracaro vadhako ukkhittāsiko ti kho bhikkhave nandirāgassetam adhivacanaṃ || || 14
sn35.238:10.1: Suñño gāmo ti kho bhikkhave channam ajjhattikānam adhivacanaṃ ||
sn35.238:10.2: cakkhuto ce pi nam bhikkhave paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī upaparikkhati rittakaññeva khāyati tucchakaññeva khāyati suññakaññeva khāyati || pa ||
sn35.238:10.3: jivhato ce pi nam bhikkhave || pa ||
sn35.238:10.4: manato ce pi nam bhikkhave paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī upaparikkhati rittakaññeva khāyati tucchakaññeva khāyati suññakaññeva khāyati || || 15
sn35.238:11.1: Corā gāmaghātakā ti kho bhikkhave channam bāhirānam āyatanānam adhivacanaṃ ||
sn35.238:12.1: Mahā udakaṇṇavo ti kho bhikkhave catunnam oghānam adhivacanaṃ ||
sn35.238:13.1: Orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayan ti kho bhikkhave sakkāyassetam adhivacanam || || 18
sn35.238:14.1: Pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemam appaṭibhayan ti kho bhikkhave nibbānassetam adhivacanaṃ || || 19
sn35.238:15.1: Kullan ti kho bhikkhave ariyassetam aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ || seyyathīdam
sn35.238:16.1: Hatthehi ca pādehi ca vāyāmo ti kho bhikkhave viriyārambhassetam adhivacanaṃ || || 21
sn35.238:17.1: Tiṇṇo pāraṅgato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo ti kho bhikkhave arahato etam adhivacanan
